papers.title: Trigonal Prismatic Coordination Field‐Induced d‐Orbital Splitting Enables σ Electron Activation for Efficient Polysulfide Conversion in Li–S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Understanding the electron‐transfer pathways and the mechanism in facilitating polysulfide conversion is crucial for the rational design of catalysts in lithium–sulfur batteries. Herein, we designed an NbSe 2 model catalyst to investigate the electron‐transfer pathways at sublayer transition metal cation sites through coordination field modulation, and revealed the relationship between electron transfer and catalytic efficiency. Moreover, the σ *– σ and π *– σ electron transfer channels at transition metal sites are identified in terms of the coordination field theory and hybrid orbital theory, where the σ *– σ channel exhibits higher electron transfer efficiency and therefore enhances the adsorption and conversion role of transition metal sites in polysulfides. The designed trigonal prismatic NbSe 2 exhibits a reversible capacity up to 799 mAh g −1 at a high rate of 5 C, and the battery maintains stability under ultra‐high sulfur loading, achieving a capacity retention rate as high as 95.85%. From an electronic perspective, this work reveals the role of coordination fields on catalytic activity, providing new insights for the rational design of catalysts in metal–S batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 삼각 프리즘형 배위장을 갖는 NbSe2 모델 촉매를 설계하여 리튬-황 배터리에서 다황화물 전환 시 전이금속 사이트의 전자전달 경로를 분석했다. 배위장 이론과 혼성 오비탈 이론을 통해 σ*-σ 전자전달 채널이 π*-σ 채널보다 전자전달 효율이 높아 다황화물의 흡착 및 전환을 촉진함을 규명했다. 설계된 삼각 프리즘형 NbSe2는 5C의 고율에서 799 mAh g-1의 가용량을 보였고, 초고황 로딩 조건에서도 95.85%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Facet-dependent anion adsorption for electrolyte-Cu interfacial stability in initially anode-free Li-metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: Initially anode-free Li-metal batteries, in which Li-metal is constructed in-situ during charging, enable increased energy density. However, interfacial degradation reactions between the electrolyte and lithiophobic Cu prevent stable solid electrolyte interphase formation on the negative electrode. Here, we elucidate a time-evolving interfacial mechanism in which adsorption of electrolyte components contributes to initial interfacial layer formation and solid electrolyte interphase stability. Most organic solvents adsorb more strongly than Li-salt compounds on Cu through van der Waals dispersion interactions. This preferential adsorption produces a solvent-dominated interfacial layer that undergoes rapid compositional reconstruction during Cu oxide reduction upon initial charging. In contrast, lithium tetrafluoroborate possesses a tetrahedral anion with isotropic charge distribution that binds strongly to the Cu (111)/(100) surfaces and native Cu oxides, producing a tetrafluoroborate-driven interfacial layer that electronically passivates the Cu interface and promotes homogeneous Li nucleation. Consequently, lithium tetrafluoroborate-containing cells achieve 62% capacity retention after 300 cycles at an areal capacity of 4.1 mAh cm−2 and electrolyte conditions of 1.5 g Ah−1 and 4 μL cm−2, establishing a mechanistic basis for adsorption-driven interfacial design in initially anode-free Li-metal batteries. Initially anode-free lithium-metal batteries are limited by unstable interfacial reactions at Cu current collectors. Here, authors show that preferential anion adsorption can stabilize the copper interface and improve long-term cycling.
papers.summary_ko: 초기 무음극(anode-free) 리튬금속전지에서 전해질-Cu 집전체 계면의 시간에 따른 변화 메커니즘을 규명했다. 대부분의 유기 용매는 반데르발스 상호작용으로 Li염보다 Cu에 더 강하게 흡착되어 충전 초기 Cu 산화물 환원 시 급격히 재구성되는 용매 주도형 계면층을 형성하지만, 사면체형 등방성 전하분포를 갖는 테트라플루오로보레이트 음이온은 Cu(111)/(100) 표면 및 자연 산화막에 강하게 결합해 Cu를 전자적으로 패시베이션하고 균일한 Li 핵생성을 유도한다. 테트라플루오로보레이트 함유 전해질 셀은 4.1 mAh cm-2의 면적용량, 1.5 g Ah-1 및 4 μL cm-2 조건에서 300사이클 후 62%의 용량 유지율을 달성했다.

papers.title: Cytotoxic drugs and bispecific T cell engagers synergize to rewire host immunity and elicit polyclonal antitumor T cell responses
papers.abstract_en: Cytotoxic therapies such as chemotherapy and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) kill tumor cells directly but are limited by resistance, dose-limiting toxicity, and failure to induce durable antitumor immunity. Here we show that tumor-associated antigen (TAA)-targeted CD28 bispecific antibodies (TAAxCD28) convert cytotoxic agents into drivers of durable antitumor immunity. In humanized mouse models, combining the HER2-directed ADC trastuzumab deruxtecan (Tras-DXd) with TAAxCD28 antibodies enhances tumor rejection and promotes durable immune memory in Tras-DXd-resistant cancers, and comparable synergy is observed with 5-fluorouracil (5-FU). This therapeutic strategy allows lower or less frequent cytotoxic drug dosing, potentially limiting systemic toxicity. Mechanistically, TAAxCD28 antibodies promote the activation and expansion of clonally-restricted tumor CD8+ T cells, and adding ADCs or chemotherapy sustains this activation while preserving a naïve/stem-like pool of tumor-specific CD8+ T cells with a diversified T cell receptor repertoire. Each cytotoxic agent supports this T cell activity through a separate innate mechanism: Tras-DXd expands and activates conventional dendritic cells, whereas 5-FU reprograms suppressive myeloid cells toward an immunostimulatory phenotype. Together, these findings support pairing cytotoxic agents with TAAxCD28 bispecifics to overcome resistance and improve long-term tumor control in refractory cancers. TAA×CD28 costimulatory bispecific antibodies are a class of immunotherapeutics that provide tumor-targeted CD28 costimulation to T cells by crosslinking CD28 on T cells to a tumor-associated antigen (TAA) expressed on tumor cells. Here, the authors show that cytotoxic therapies reprogram the tumor microenvironment and augment the antitumor immunity induced by TAA×CD28 bispecifics.
papers.summary_ko: 세포독성 항암제와 이중특이 T세포 인게이저를 병용하여 숙주 면역을 재편하고 다클론성 항종양 T세포 반응을 유도하는 연구로, 배터리 소재와 무관한 암 면역치료 분야 논문이다. (제목 기반 추정)
